correctness.rationale: The theorem uses the finite-graph GHM circulation criterion within its hypotheses. Every wheel face is a triangle; any nonzero integral yields excitation rate at least one third, forced to equality by three-step refractory spacing. On a finite periodic tail that forces global colour advancement. Exact nine-state and three-state transfer matrices give the cycle and extinction formulas; the expected factorizations were independently reconstructed with rational arithmetic and complete functional-graph enumerations for n=3..10.
